Document title

Source: R/metadata.R
html_title.Rd

The document's title as the HTML standard defines document.title: the text of the first <title> element in the HTML namespace, with leading and trailing whitespace removed and runs of whitespace collapsed to one space. An SVG <title> does not count.

Usage

html_title(x)

Arguments

x

A zuhtml_document, or a zuhtml_nodeset whose document is used.

Value

A single string, NA when the document has no <title>.

See also

Other metadata: html_json_ld(), html_meta(), html_microdata()

Examples

html_title(html_parse("<title>  Annual\n  report </title><p>Body"))
#> [1] "Annual report"
html_title(html_parse("<p>No title"))
#> [1] NA
